name: Early local-format token prediction
mechanism: Earliest MLPs (m0-m3) plus a4 supply the local, surface-level prediction of format punctuation, digits and word-piece continuations that dominate densely templated listing text.

name: Name completion in compressed listings
mechanism: Early m0/m2 directions finish the remaining word-pieces of a proper name or stock label that is already half-emitted inside a tightly packed index or heading entry (Enter|tainment, GOOG|LE, ABleak| House).

name: Place-name suffix completion
mechanism: Early-layer machinery emits the predictable word-final piece of an English place or venue name (-gate, -head, -ster, -tainment) and the trailing digit of a letter+digit map code.

name: Parallel heading-list continuation
mechanism: Uses the repeated shape of an ongoing list of same-form entries ('#### Town', 'AName Hotel') to predict the next entry's name or its shared head noun.

name: Numeric tail of index entries
mechanism: Predicts the number or suffix that closes a compact tabular entry: the grid digit after a letter, the trailing digits of a 'Pop 90,300' figure, or the ending of a section label.

name: Line break ending a list entry
mechanism: m3 directions and head 4.8 mark that a one-line map-key or heading entry is complete, driving the newline that starts the next numbered entry.

name: Map grid-reference digit
mechanism: Predicts the digit of the letter+digit coordinate appended to venue names in map keys (D4, F3, B3, E1), i.e. the numeric half of a two-token grid code.

name: Newline between heading entries
mechanism: Fires on the boundary token separating consecutive same-form entries in a run of '####' headings or numbered map lines, emitting the break rather than any content.

name: All-caps category tag emission
mechanism: After a venue or event name, produces the uppercase category label glued to it (CLUB, FERRY, MUSEUM, AIR SHOW) and the newline that closes it.

name: Repeated-word induction copying
mechanism: Layer-4 attention heads locate an earlier occurrence of the current partial word or phrase in the passage and copy its continuation (Activ|ities, Marg|ate, Chiche|ster).

name: Letter-plus-digit map codes
mechanism: Completes the alphanumeric locator code closing a map-key line, with the same directions also predicting the next label in a heading run.

name: End of parenthetical detail block
mechanism: Detects that a bracketed practical-details block (hours, tube, URL) has closed and emits the following paragraph break or the stock label that comes next.

name: Newline between numbered entries
mechanism: Almost purely the line break between consecutive numbered map-key lines, where the model must end one entry and begin the next index number.

name: Uppercase category-tag completion
mechanism: Finishes the shouted category suffix appended to a listing name (BOOK|S, FER|RY, CIN|EMA, NEIGHBOURH|OOD) once its first pieces are on the page.

name: Mid-word subword continuation
mechanism: Early/mid MLPs plus layer-4 heads carry the completion of a word already begun, in prose, labels and code alike, independent of what kind of line it sits on.

name: Closing token of coded fields
mechanism: Supplies the token that shuts a compact coded field: the digit ending a grid reference or the ')' ending a parenthesised website address.

name: Continuation inside numbers and names
mechanism: Predicts the next piece of a partly written number or name, including the thousands comma inside 'Pop 151,200' and word-internal pieces of place names.

name: Town heading then population
mechanism: Handles the guide's town-section template: the next place name in a parallel heading series and the population figure that immediately follows it.

name: Section-header line breaks
mechanism: Mid-layer MLPs (m11-m14) mark that a standalone structural header or category label is finished, driving the newline that ends the header line.

name: Boilerplate padding inside MAP tag
mechanism: Predicts the whitespace and GOOGLE pieces inside the recurring '(  MAP   GOOGLE MAP )' listing boilerplate that follows a venue's category tag.

name: GOOGLE MAP template tokens
mechanism: Same boilerplate machinery, focused on the fixed sequence itself: the space opening the bracket and the 'LE' completing GOOGLE.

name: Newline after category label
mechanism: Emits the line break directly after an all-caps venue category or bold sub-header, the point where the entry switches from name to details block.

name: Fixed-phrase next-token copying
mechanism: Continues a memorised multi-token string once begun: GOOGLE in the map tag, 'St Pancras' after King's Cross, the digit of a postcode district.

name: Postcode district digit
mechanism: After a street address, predicts the number completing the London postcode district (EC|1, EC|2, W|1), together with other fixed address-field tokens.

name: Standalone sub-heading lines
mechanism: Recognises the guide's one-word structural lines (Bus, Train, Gatwick, Sights, Sleeping) and the head noun closing a listed proper name, then their line break.

name: Address postcode digit
mechanism: Very cleanly the digit that completes a London postcode district after a street address ('54 Frith St, W|1'), plus the tube marker beginning the station field.

name: Category tag onset after venue
mechanism: Emits the first capital of the all-caps category tag fused onto the end of a venue name (Museum|M USEUM, Portrait Gallery|G ALLERY, Rough Trade East|M USIC).

name: Tube marker before station
mechanism: Predicts the small glyph that introduces the nearest-tube field inside a practical-info bracket, and similarly the digits of the adjacent price range.

name: Space before info-field marker
mechanism: Supplies the padding space that precedes a field marker (opening-hours 'h', MAP) inside the semicolon-separated practical-details block.

name: Preposition before a date
mechanism: Mid-late MLPs predict the function word that introduces a century or year in historical description ('ranging from the 13th', 'added between 1394', 'in 1978').

name: Clause-linking function words
mechanism: Predicts the verb or preposition that links a noun to what follows it in expository prose ('elements that included', 'composites of hydrogen', 'such as sulfur').

name: Stock section-label prediction
mechanism: After a structural header, produces the guide's canonical label for that slot (Sights, Bus, Train, Gatwick) rather than any content word.

name: Parallel place-name headings
mechanism: Continues a run of same-form headings by predicting the next town or house name in the series (Sandwich, Dover, Hastings, Eastbourne, Ramsgate).

name: Hyphen and ordinal suffixes
mechanism: Predicts the joining hyphen of a compound modifier ('first-rate', 'best-looking', '14th- to 20th') and the ordinal ending of a number ('3rd fl', '40th fl').

name: Space before opening-hours marker
mechanism: Almost entirely one slot: the space after a price or address field's semicolon that precedes the opening-hours marker in a venue's details bracket.

name: Item-ending break or next field
mechanism: Head 5.7 with m1/m15/a8 detects that a self-contained item or sentence has ended, driving the newline that closes it or the marker that opens the next field.

name: Paragraph break after sentence
mechanism: Attention-layer-5 directions fire on the newline immediately after a completed sentence or entry, splitting the text into blocks.

name: Blank line before subheading
mechanism: Produces the second newline of the blank line that separates finished prose from the next '####' subheading or the next same-form list entry.

name: Break between numbered entries
mechanism: Late-layer version of the map-key boundary: the newline ending one numbered venue line before the next index number, plus the ';' separating listing fields.

name: Field marker after semicolon
mechanism: After a semicolon in a venue listing, emits the letter that opens the next practical-info field ('m' of mains, tube marker), i.e. field switching inside the bracket.
